title: Tiktaalik is a published Devonian fossil, not a slogan
summary: Daeschler, Shubin, and Jenkins described a Devonian tetrapod-like fish in Nature in 2006.
body: Edward B. Daeschler, Neil H. Shubin, and Farish A. Jenkins, Jr., "A Devonian tetrapod-like fish and the evolution of the tetrapod body plan" (Nature, 2006), described Tiktaalik. The v1 article lists it as a transitional fossil. The paper is one fossil study in a larger body of evidence. A single fossil does not carry the whole theory. Archaeopteryx is also named in the v1 article; a specimen page was not successfully opened in this pass, so Archaeopteryx is not given a source here.
